pr_title: Don't flip catcher plate contents when catcher changes direction
pr_body:
- Fixes #11112

I added a skin configuration key for whether the catcher plate should be flipped.
It is `true` for the default skin, and `false` for any legacy skin. Not sure how to make it customizable any further.

issue_context.title: Catcher plate and fruits shouldn't be mirrored/fipped when catcher direction changes
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 

Catcher sprite is mirrored as the catcher direction changes, but the caught objects on the plate and hit lighting shouldn't change relative position.
Stable does not mirror catcher plate.
comments:
Yeah, not sure about this one. I kinda like it the new way, but i think some players will complain about this change.

At very least, we want it to be customisable and use the old display method for legacy skins.

> At very least, we want it to be customisable and use the old display method for legacy skins.

Is this still the current accepted solution? If so I'd be happy to implement it.
I think we definitely want to leave this as a potential customisation for the future (ie. the skin or user can choose whether they want this to be on or off), so that sounds good.

review_comments: Still not sure about adding new values to these areas (was intended to only be for actually supported values in osu-stable skin versions) but I don't have a better suggestion for now.
